$description: Breakpoint, grid, and per-surface responsive rules. Derived from design-tokens.json breakpoints/grid/courseGrid plus ux/RESPONSIVE_BEHAVIOR.md's per-screen adaptation notes captured in ux/SCREEN_UX_SPECS.md.

coursePlayer.$description: The defining responsive behavior in the product — the single largest platform-specific divergence, explicitly sanctioned.
coursePlayer.desktopAndAbove: two-column: content-left (~70%) / curriculum-right (~30%, persistent sidebar with course-level ProgressBar + section/lesson list)
coursePlayer.belowDesktop: single-column; curriculum is NOT inline — reached via a 'Curriculum' affordance opening a BottomSheet containing the same section/lesson list

dataTable.belowDesktop: each row collapses to a stacked label:value card — never horizontally-scrolling or cramped

learningPathDetails.allBreakpoints: member-course list is ALWAYS single-column (numbered sequence reads better as a list than a grid, even on Large Desktop) — a deliberate exception to the standard course-grid.

certificatesGrid.note: certificate cards may cap at 2-3 columns even at Large Desktop — they carry more visual weight than a CourseCard; a layout judgment, not a token change.

myLearningFilter.belowDesktop: status filter renders as a simple 3-segment control near the top rather than chips — functionally identical to CategoryChip selection, no new component.

formWidthCap.$description: Login, Register, Quiz, Quiz Results, Demo Checkout, Profile, Settings, Course Editor forms, Lesson Editor, Quiz Editor all use a centered form-width-capped column at every breakpoint rather than stretching full-bleed on wide viewports.

courseDetailsSticky.mobile: sticky primary CTA pinned at the bottom of the viewport
courseDetailsSticky.web: CTA inline in the hero block, not sticky (page short enough at Desktop widths)

typographyResponsive.note: Only display.* and heading.h1/h2 scale down below desktop — everything else (heading.h3/h4, body.*, label.*, caption) stays constant across breakpoints.
